mapper.select: SELECT * FROM proj_project_stage_snapshot WHERE ORDER BY operated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{query.limit} OFFSET #{query.offset}

SELECT close_snapshot.* FROM proj_project_stage_snapshot close_snapshot WHERE close_snapshot.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND close_snapshot.project_id = #{query.projectId} AND close_snapshot.operation_type = 'EXCEPTION_CLOSE' AND close_snapshot.deleted = b'0' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM proj_project_stage_snapshot reopen_snapshot WHERE reopen_snapshot.tenant_id = close_snapshot.tenant_id AND reopen_snapshot.project_id = close_snapshot.project_id AND reopen_snapshot.operation_type = 'REOPEN' AND reopen_snapshot.related_snapshot_id = close_snapshot.id AND reopen_snapshot.deleted = b'0' ) ORDER BY close_snapshot.operated_at DESC, close_snapshot.id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
